answer_1.quote: Text summarization aims to condense lengthy documents into concise, coherent, and human‑readable texts … We investigate the effect of generated summary length on 14 summarization metrics.

answer_2.quote: We investigate the impact of generated summary length on 14 distinct metrics.

answer_4.quote: We leverage human judgment results from Fabbri et al., encompassing 100 samples … We adopt human annotation "coherence" scores as a holistic summary quality measure.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators provided coherence scores for each summary as the evaluation criterion.
